C264.notes: SER AS-SG-002. Photo confirmed (no text drip). Value side rice stalk left · big 10 · CENTS · 1973 · SINGAPORE (arms / lion fish obverse not shown). First 10 cents in the vault — six years after first-year C250 / AS-SG-001 (1967 20¢). Early independent SGD small change — hawker / bus / shop tills while the republic’s coinage was still young. Second Singapore flip. Singapore flips now 2.
